title: trachyandra pauciflora
intro: Trachyandra pauciflora, commonly known as the "Yellow Wild Onion", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asphodelaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. Further research is required to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications of Trachyandra pauciflora.
